digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family value maps and boundary guards
propositions: the ticket-type map definition is duplicated across two Cloud and DataCenter adapter modules, creating risk of silent divergence
the boundary guard protecting STATUS and PRIORITY maps against duplication does not cover the ticket-type map

consolidating the three value maps into a single canonical definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py following the J2 pattern eliminates the duplication and preserves module-attribute visibility through aliased imports
the two duplicate ticket-type mappings are content-identical across all four local types (task, story, bug, epic) prior to consolidation
extending the one-literal guard to cover the ticket-type map prevents future reintroduction of duplicated definitions by failing the build
